posts.author: SHIknowz
posts.text: read-layer censorship is nastier than people realize if a transaction gets censored, you can at least detect something is wrong but if your rpc or indexer simply doesnt return a transaction, log or piece of state, how does the user know whether it never happened or they just

posts.author: SHIknowz
posts.text: does Shinzō replace RPCs? today, builders stich together RPCs for raw data + indexers for usable data Shinzō collapses both into one verifiable read layer Writes are separate, but the current read stack suddenly looks pretty awkward

posts.author: SHIknowz
posts.text: validators produce blockchain data but don't get to participate in the business built around selling it. a $2b+ economy... Shinzō routes 70% of consumer payments to the supply side: Generators + Hosts. much closer to how crypto economics should work ❤️
